decisions: Your rule from 07:20 today, being followed: work continuously, not stopping at 3 pm, until you say stop; pause only at 95% of the 5-hour limit and resume when it resets. The PC is kept awake until 23:59 and checks run every 30 minutes until 18:43; I'll extend them if you haven't said stop.

Your rule from tonight, being followed: no free models, no answer testing and no fixes made around test scores until Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu are complete. You also said to leave the limits and keep running, so I've lifted the 18% weekly stop line. Tell me if you meant only the free model limits.

Start a fresh session when convenient. This one has grown large, so each step costs more of your limits. A new session reading the handoff would cost far less. Scheduled checks would need setting up again in it, which it can do itself.
Keep the app open and the PC awake. Scheduled reports only run while this session is open, and PC jobs stop if the PC sleeps.

A person should check the rates. All exact records are marked unreviewed. First: Andhra Pradesh's enhanced relief. The order says "over and above SDRF norms", and I recorded paddy's Rs.25,000 as the total paid, not as added to Rs.17,000.
Spot-check my marks if you can. I marked the 179 answers myself, and read native-language answers only to about 520 characters.
next: Working through the coverage grid (tools/coverage_grid.py), gap by gap, as your rules say. All records below are untested and marked unreviewed.

Corrections I made to my own records: removed three sentences that were my inference, not in the source (market fee, farm power hours, farm connection order).

Still missing. Andhra Pradesh: electricity duty rate per category, women's stamp concession (none found), ration entitlement, used-vehicle tax, SC self-employment loan subsidy (order queued for OCR), dairy and solar pump subsidies. Tamil Nadu: women's 1% registration fee cut (press only), wildlife crop damage rates (2016 order not online), Rabi 2026-27 insurance dates, KMS 2026-27 paddy incentive, land conversion.

Some budget items are announcements with no order held yet, and the records say so.

New records aren't proven through full answers. 8 Andhra Pradesh records were added from the orders (pensions, fishing ban, poultry). Code finds them for sample questions, but no full answer has been asked since. An old age question also gets all 4 pension records, so narrowing is still needed. The pension order doesn't give age or eligibility rules.

Still open from tonight's reading: Tamil Nadu's notified electricity tax rate (the Act gives only 5% to 10%). Tamil Nadu's arrears settlement Act 24 of 2023 isn't entered, because its application window may have closed and I don't hold the latest date. Policy-note rates should be confirmed against the orders behind them.

The run stalled for about an hour tonight and I missed it. Groq's free daily tokens for the writing model ran out (195,070 of 200,000), and the stronger Gemini models were also at their limits. Only 1 new answer came in, and each failed question wasted about 20 minutes. Now the run stops after 3 misses in a row, and this page shows a stall after 45 minutes.

New answers come from a weaker model. Each new answer now records which model wrote it. Answers from gemini-3.1-flash-lite must be read by hand and may need asking again on a stronger model. The fisheries answer still leaves out the amount, because that rate isn't in the exact records yet.
Andhra Pradesh finance is thin: 288 passages before today's documents are built in, and nothing yet on electricity duty, guideline values, tax arrears or women's concessions.
Failed downloads: the Andhra Pradesh Socio Economic Survey, the power tariff note, Gender Budget and some horticulture files. Other routes still to try.
Tamil Nadu's horticulture site is slow, about 7 minutes a file, so 15 orders are downloading separately and go in a later build.
Two sites have certificate problems: apagrisnet.gov.in and ctd.tn.gov.in. I don't bypass those checks, so other sources are needed.
No full re-run since the fixes, so the 157 of 179 doesn't show their effect yet.
No Nvidia GPU on this PC. It has Intel Arc graphics, 16 GB of RAM and a CPU-only PyTorch, so builds and local models run on the CPU for now.

log.text: Monitoring station set up on this page, with the architecture, diagrams and techniques updated. Today: first hand-marked test, 157 of 179 good, marked by me before the fixes. Added 36 exact rates across Andhra Pradesh deeds, vehicle tax and relief, Tamil Nadu vehicle tax and Chennai profession tax, all unreviewed. Engine: 3 checks added, 231 code tests pass. Listed 18,441 Andhra Pradesh orders and about 3,300 official PDFs. Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu aren't done.

You removed the fixed date, so work goes in logical order: collect, ask, read, fix, then the next state. Checked this page against the code and corrected it: tests are 231, exact records and scan reading are shown, and stale document lists are gone. The older Version 1 tabs are kept as history and weren't checked.
The aspect run stalled for about an hour because the free model limits ran out. It now uses gemini-3.1-flash-lite and stops itself after 3 misses in a row.

The test run is paused at 56 of 136 because it was too slow on free limits. 8 Andhra Pradesh records added from official orders: pensions, fishing ban relief and poultry. Next: more rates from documents already held, then the open data gaps.

8 more records from documents already held: Tamil Nadu pensions, fishing relief and electricity tax range; Andhra Pradesh rooftop solar for BC consumers and the closed property tax waiver. Test run stays paused. None of these has been through a full answer yet.

On your rule, no free models and no testing. 50 exact records entered tonight, including Tamil Nadu's official paddy incentive and crop loan waiver. PC is downloading picked orders with no model. New: each order's number and what it replaces is read automatically and carried through to the answer.

Morning report, 06:58. Since the 22:22 report: 49 exact records entered (42 agriculture, 6 finance, 1 date), 1 repeat removed. None has been through a full answer; all are marked unreviewed. Documents: 115 scanned Tamil Nadu agriculture orders fetched and read by OCR (27 routine ones dropped, 28 named from their abstracts), 1 Andhra Pradesh DEEPAM-2 order added. Builds: finance AP (+7 chunks), agriculture AP (no change), finance TN (no change), agriculture TN (+2,890 chunks from the scans). What failed: Tesseract crashed on one page at 01:40 and stopped the Tamil Nadu agriculture build; fixed so a bad page is skipped, test added, rebuilt by 02:56. My own failure: the hourly checks from 02:00 to 06:00 did not run, so the PC sat idle for about four hours after 02:57. Andhra Pradesh, added: horticulture subsidies (polyhouse, shade net, mulching, farm pond, nets, orchards, mushroom, pack house, machinery), paddy procurement KMS 2026-27, electricity duty range (from a Bill), free LPG cylinders and piped gas subsidy, pension eligibility, Annadatha, livestock insurance, Kharif 2026 drought, mango insurance date. Andhra Pradesh, still missing: electricity duty rate per category, guideline values, wildlife damage compensation, used-vehicle tax, women's stamp concession, ration entitlement, field-crop machinery subsidy. Tamil Nadu, added: state pension eligibility, Uzhavar Pathukappu, ration entitlement, unemployment aid, machinery hire 2026-27, solar fencing, threshing floors, drones for women, soil conservation, skimming wells, custom hiring centres, SC/ST borewells, ponds, dairy, native breeds, solar dryers. Tamil Nadu, still missing: women's 1% registration fee cut (press only), wildlife crop damage rates (G.O.(D) No.141 of 2016 not found online), Rabi 2026-27 insurance dates, notified electricity tax rate, KMS 2026-27 paddy incentive. Usage: 5-hour 5%, weekly 19% (last report's 20 and 14 were wrong; real then was 24 and 15). You asked me to keep going until 3 pm; I am.
